source.notes: Scanned school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected against the page images. No school name is printed. Printed header: 2nd Term Examination, Class: VII, Subject: Science, Time: 2Hrs, Marks: 80; footer 'Std7/Science/7th Feb 2025/73'. Although the file is listed on icseboard.org under class 8 / biology, the paper itself prints Class VII, so this pack is filed as class 7. examYear 2025 is from the printed footer date (7th Feb 2025). The Science paper has Section A Biology (25 Marks), Section B Chemistry (30 Marks) and Section C Physics (25 Marks); one pack is built per section. The 80 marks and 2 hours apply to the whole Science paper. Group totals are kept as one entry (never split). Student ticks/handwriting on the scan are ignored. No answer key is printed. This pack holds Section A (Biology), 25 marks; listed marks total 25.

Match the terms given in column A with the most appropriate ones in column B and rewrite correct matching pairs:
COLUMN A: i) Chloroplast; ii) Glucose and Oxygen; iii) Carbon dioxide and water; iv) Sunlight; v) Xylem and Phloem

questions.text:
Choose the Correct alternatives. Write the complete sentence against the correct question number.
i) The organ which produces urea is :
a) Lungs b) Liver c) Skin d) Kidneys
ii) ATP stands for :
a) Adenosine Tetraphosphate b) Adenine Triphosphate c) Adenosine Triphosphate d) Adenosine Triphosphorous
iii) The process of expulsion of the urine to the outside is called :
a) Circulation b) Urination c) Respiration d) Excretion
iv) The largest part of the brain :
a) Cerebellum b) Cerebrum c) Medulla Oblongata d) Brain Stem
v) Which is not part of the neuron :
a) cell body b) axon c) dendrites d) cranium
